name: ihasmail
description: ihasmail — a fast, modern JMAP webmail for Stalwart Mail Server

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w web && npm run test -w server
scripts.dev:mock: concurrently -n mock,server,web -c yellow,blue,magenta "npm run mock -w server" "STALWART_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8788 npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:mock:no-future-release: concurrently -n mock,server,web -c yellow,blue,magenta "npm run mock:no-future-release -w server" "STALWART_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8788 npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
